title: File:Silos de Trinidad, Flores, Uruguay 01.jpg
author: BiblioJu
description: Silo plant in Trinidad, capital of the Flores department, Uruguay In January 2025, the largest mural in Uruguay up to that time was inaugurated. The work, created by the artist José Gallino, depicts two schoolchildren with a horse in a rural landscape that evokes the identity of the territory, the value of education, and the deep connection of the community with its landscape.
categories: Murals in Uruguay|Trinidad, Uruguay|Self-published work|Silos in Uruguay
